name: odoo-mcp-connector
description: Connects Claude to the Vision Lighting live Odoo instance — read everything, plus restricted writes (products, variants, images, pricelists, quotations, project tasks, helpdesk tickets, contacts, open manufacturing orders, luminaire schedules (import, line images, source documents), and date-only ETA edits on purchase orders, PO lines, transfers and transfer lines, invoice forecasts on quotes and orders) and PDFMonkey datasheet generation. Quotation edits are limited to draft/sent orders; confirming a quote into a sales order stays manual. Manufacturing edits are limited to MOs that are not done or cancelled; marking an MO done stays manual.

odoo_username.title: Odoo login email
odoo_username.description: Your Odoo login email EXACTLY as it appears in Odoo — logins are case-sensitive (e.g. JoshS@... will not work typed as joshs@...). Check Odoo > Settings > My Profile if unsure.

live_url.title: Odoo URL
live_url.description: Base URL of the live instance, e.g. https://your-company.odoo.com

live_db.title: Database name
live_db.description: Live database name (ask your Odoo admin if unsure).

live_api_key.title: Odoo API key
live_api_key.description: API key from the live instance (Settings > My Profile > Account Security > API Keys).

pdfmonkey_api_key.title: PDFMonkey API key (optional)
pdfmonkey_api_key.description: Only needed for datasheet generation. Leave blank otherwise.

pdfmonkey_template_id.title: PDFMonkey template ID (optional)
pdfmonkey_template_id.description: The PDFMonkey datasheet template ID. Only needed for datasheet generation.

staging_url.title: Staging URL
staging_url.description: Odoo.sh staging database URL. Leave blank to disable the staging target entirely.

staging_db.title: Staging DB
staging_db.description: Staging database name (usually the hostname without the '.dev.odoo.com' suffix).

staging_api_key.title: Staging API Key
staging_api_key.description: Only needed if the staging database wants a different key from live. Odoo.sh staging is a copy of production, so the live key usually works — leave blank to reuse it.
